title: Case Illustrations — The Days a Lateness Is Assessed Over on Belrose Promotional Financing Plans
content:
# Case Illustrations — The Days a Lateness Is Assessed Over on Belrose Promotional Financing Plans

The days a lateness on a Belrose Promotional Financing Plan is assessed over always run to the handling date; where they start depends on the plan's standing, on whether automatic payment is in force and on what the month just ending holds.

1. Where automatic payment is in force on the plan **and** a payment has been sent back unpaid on it in the whole month ending on the handling date, the days run from the day the term's automatic payment grace ends after the missed due date to the handling date, and they are never fewer than none.
2. Where the plan stands past due at the handling date **and** no payment has settled on it in the whole month ending on the handling date, the days run from the missed due date itself to the handling date, the due date counting as day zero.
3. In every other case, the days run from the day the term's grace period ends after the missed due date to the handling date, and they are never fewer than none.

## Figures by term

| Term | Automatic payment grace, calendar days | Grace period, calendar days |
|---|---|---|
| 6-Month Deferred Interest Plan | 3 | 3 |
| 12-Month Deferred Interest Plan | 3 | 3 |
| 18-Month Deferred Interest Plan | 3 | 5 |
| 24-Month Equal Payment Plan | 5 | 5 |
| 36-Month Equal Payment Plan | 5 | 7 |
| 48-Month Bridal Equal Payment Plan | 5 | 7 |

## Cases on hypothetical dates

Take a missed due date of 1 June and a handling date of 20 June, giving 19 calendar days between them, on a plan written on the 24-Month Equal Payment Plan, whose automatic payment grace is 5 calendar days and whose grace period is 5 calendar days.

| The plan | The days assessed over |
|---|---|
| Automatic payment in force, a payment sent back unpaid in the month just ending | 19 less the automatic payment grace of 5, that is 14 |
| Past due, no payment settled in the month just ending | 19, counted from the missed due date itself with 1 June as day zero |
| Active, no automatic payment | 19 less the grace period of 5, that is 14 |

Where the same plan is handled on 3 June, 2 calendar days after the missed due date, the first and third readings would fall below none and therefore stand at none, while the second would stand at 2.
